# Business logic in services

`W7` · Coding rule

New business logic in app/Services//, thin controllers. Frozen files: never add methods to CompanylController.php, app/Globals/Helper.php, app/Helpers/helpers.php, app/Globals/Routes.php. Never call web controllers from API controllers
